payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the proposed model with other existing models in the context of machine reading comprehension (MRC).

claims.text: The proposed model outperforms the SAN baseline in terms of Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores.
The model outperforms the more complex R.M.-Reader + Verifier model by 0.7 in F1 score.
The proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the development dataset without using pre-trained large language models.
The model is compared with various existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding substrings in passages.
